scope: Browser source-side organizational ownership and selected-side evidence review inside the existing acceptance catalog
productDirectionInput: AI competition: automatic fidelity acceptance and BUG detection for developed projects; implementation choices delegated by the user

rulesApplied.rule: An extension inherits the incumbent world and composition; no DESIGN.md change without an approved durable system change.

New worlds and approved system changes require token-bearing DESIGN.md plus .impeccable/design.json. Ordinary extensions compare the final build to the incumbent, preserve its files, and report checked evidence and pre-existing drift.
Use observed tokens and components as the source of truth, preserve canonical values, and regenerate the sidecar when regenerating root DESIGN.md.

designPairDecision.reason: No new world, approved system change, new shared token, shipping raster or comp applies. Scoped controls reuse existing CSS variables, component treatments and layout conventions. The ordinary-extension rule requires comparison and preservation, not unrelated global documentation repair.

incumbentComparison.observed: All 10 stored dark/light canonical palette pairs match current CSS. The scoped component resolves colors through incumbent variables.
System UI stack, 12px workbench copy, 13/14px headings and 11px mono identifiers inherit the existing dense Operate surface.
Native select/input/checkbox/details controls; 44px actions; 6px small radius; 1px borders; token-based surface, hover, focus and status treatments.

Form, stored history, selected review and evidence disclosure join the incumbent internal-scroll workbench; responsive fields become one column and facts stack. All eight recorded layouts have no horizontal overflow.

Explicit source side and confirmation, stored history distinct from live verification, source-change warning, redacted URL displays, protected on-demand evidence and executionReady false preserve the existing task semantics.
No new world, approved comp or shipping raster. Displayed saved screenshots are functional evidence content; PNG captures are test artifacts.
